Tezi develops autonomous artificial intelligence designed to manage the entire hiring process. Its core product, Max, operates as an AI recruiting agent, proactively handling candidate sourcing, screening, and interview scheduling. This sophisticated AI is trained by experienced hiring managers and recruiters, aiming to significantly streamline the recruitment workflow for organizations.

Founded in 2024 by Jason James and Raghavendra Prabhu, Tezi originated from the insight that substantial parts of recruitment could be optimized through specialized AI. The founders sought to alleviate recruiters from mundane tasks, enabling them to focus on strategic engagement and human elements of talent acquisition.

Tezi serves heads of talent and established talent teams aiming to enhance recruitment efficiency and scale operations. The company's vision centers on transforming talent acquisition by integrating intelligent AI agents that automate repetitive aspects, empowering organizations to attract and secure top talent more effectively.
Autonomous and Proactive Capabilities

: Handles end-to-end workflows—sourcing from 750M profiles, screening thousands of resumes instantly, scheduling via calendars, and providing 24/7 candidate support—reducing time-to-hire from weeks to minutes.[1][2][4]
: Built by founders who hired 1,000+ employees, with input from elite recruiters, ensuring meticulous, real-world optimized experiences.[3]
: Works with existing systems, focusing on objective criteria to boost candidate experience without demographic biases.[2][5]

本記事で取り上げる Tezi は、生成AI領域において大きな注目を集めているスタートアップの一つです。2023年に Raghavendra Prabhu 氏と Jason James 氏によって設立されました。採用業務に関する課題、たとえば 「候補者探しに時間がかかる」「面接日程の調整が煩雑」 などを、AIエージェント「Max」による完全自動化を通じて解決するのが彼らのビジネスの核心です。
Tezi は、7.5 億件の候補者データベースとマルチエージェント型の生成AI によって独自の強みを発揮し、候補者発掘から面接調整までを一気通貫で自動化している点が際立っています。
